subject: Biology SL
title: Biology SL Paper 2 Section A Mock v2

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Blood glucose concentration was measured after a glucose drink in healthy participants and in participants with impaired glucose regulation.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Compare the glucose responses of the two groups.
markscheme: Both groups show an increase in blood glucose after the drink.
The impaired group reaches a higher peak and remains elevated for longer / returns toward baseline more slowly.
markschemeJa: 両群とも飲用後に血糖値が上昇する。
障害群はピークがより高く、高値が長く続く／基準値への回復が遅い。
parts.modelAnswer: Both groups rise, but the impaired group peaks higher and declines more slowly.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 両群とも上昇しますが、障害群はピークが高く低下も遅いです。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Calculate the percentage increase from 0 to 60 minutes in the impaired group.
markscheme: Increase = 10.8 − 5.7 = 5.1 mmol dm⁻³.
Percentage increase = 5.1 ÷ 5.7 × 100 ≈ 89.5% (accept 89–90%).
markschemeJa: 増加量＝10.8－5.7＝5.1 mmol dm⁻³。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how insulin normally contributes to restoring blood glucose concentration after a meal.
markscheme: High blood glucose stimulates insulin release from pancreatic beta cells.
Insulin promotes glucose uptake by target cells / increases membrane glucose transport in relevant tissues.
Insulin promotes storage of glucose as glycogen and reduces blood glucose toward the set range.
markschemeJa: 高血糖により膵臓β細胞からインスリン分泌が促進される。
インスリンは標的細胞へのグルコース取り込みを促進する／関連組織の膜輸送を高める。
グルコースのグリコーゲン貯蔵を促進し血糖値を設定範囲へ下げる。
parts.modelAnswer: Insulin is released when glucose is high and promotes glucose uptake and storage as glycogen, lowering blood glucose.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 血糖が高いとインスリンが分泌され、グルコース取り込みとグリコーゲン貯蔵を促して血糖を下げます。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Evaluate whether the data alone prove that the impaired group produces no insulin.
markscheme: The slower fall is consistent with reduced insulin secretion or reduced response to insulin.
The data do not measure insulin concentration directly, so absence of insulin is not demonstrated.
Other explanations such as insulin resistance are possible; direct insulin measurements / further tests are needed.
markschemeJa: 低下が遅いことはインスリン分泌低下またはインスリン応答低下と一致する。
データはインスリン濃度を直接測定していないため、インスリンが存在しないことは示せない。
インスリン抵抗性など他の説明も可能で、直接測定や追加試験が必要。
parts.modelAnswer: The pattern suggests impaired regulation but does not prove no insulin is produced. Insulin resistance or reduced secretion could both explain the data, so direct insulin measurements are required.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 調節障害は示唆されますが、インスリンが全く作られない証明にはなりません。抵抗性や分泌低下も考えられるため直接測定が必要です。

parts.label: (e)
parts.question: Suggest two features of the study design that would improve confidence in the conclusion.
markscheme: Use a sufficiently large sample / replicate measurements in each group.
Match or control relevant variables such as age, fasting time, diet, activity or body mass.
markschemeJa: 十分な標本数を用いる／各群で反復測定する。
年齢、絶食時間、食事、活動量、体格など関連変数をそろえる。
parts.modelAnswer: Use larger matched groups and control factors such as fasting time and recent activity.
parts.modelAnswerJa: より大きく条件をそろえた群を使い、絶食時間や直前の活動などを統制します。

stimulus.title: Blood glucose after a glucose drink

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Equal masses of water and ethanol received the same amount of thermal energy.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate how many times greater the temperature rise of ethanol is than that of water.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why water shows the smaller temperature rise.
markscheme: Water molecules form extensive hydrogen bonds.
A significant amount of added energy is used to disrupt/rearrange hydrogen bonds before increasing molecular kinetic energy.
Water therefore has a high specific heat capacity and changes temperature relatively slowly.
markschemeJa: 水分子間には多数の水素結合が形成される。
加えたエネルギーの多くが分子運動を高める前に水素結合の切断・再形成に使われる。
そのため水は比熱容量が高く温度変化が小さい。
parts.modelAnswer: Hydrogen bonding means more energy is needed to raise water's temperature, giving water a high specific heat capacity.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 水素結合のため水温を上げるのに多くのエネルギーが必要で、水は高い比熱容量をもちます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: State one biological advantage of water's high specific heat capacity.
markscheme: It buffers organisms/aquatic habitats against rapid temperature changes / helps maintain stable internal temperature.
markschemeJa: 生物や水域の急激な温度変化を抑える／内部温度を安定させる。
parts.modelAnswerJa: 温度を安定させるのに役立ちます。

stimulus.title: Temperature change after equal energy input

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Glucose uptake was measured in intestinal epithelial cells with and without an ATP-production inhibitor.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate the percentage reduction at 8 mmol dm⁻³ glucose.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why uptake decreases but does not fall to zero.
markscheme: ATP is required directly or indirectly to maintain active transport / ion gradients used in glucose absorption.
Reducing ATP production weakens active transport and lowers glucose uptake.
Some glucose can still enter by passive/facilitated diffusion, so uptake remains above zero.
markschemeJa: ATPはグルコース吸収に使う能動輸送やイオン勾配維持に直接・間接に必要。
ATP産生低下で能動輸送が弱まり取り込みが減少する。
一部は受動輸送・促進拡散で入れるため0にはならない。
parts.modelAnswer: ATP-dependent transport is reduced, but passive or facilitated diffusion can continue.
parts.modelAnswerJa: ATP依存輸送は低下しますが、受動・促進拡散は続くため0にはなりません。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how microvilli increase nutrient absorption.
markscheme: Microvilli increase the membrane surface area available for absorption.
A larger surface can contain more transport proteins, increasing uptake capacity.
markschemeJa: 微絨毛は吸収に使える膜表面積を増やす。
広い表面により多くの輸送タンパク質を配置でき吸収能力が高まる。
parts.modelAnswer: Microvilli increase surface area and allow more transport proteins.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 微絨毛は表面積を増やし、より多くの輸送タンパク質を配置できます。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Antibody concentration was measured after first and second exposure to the same antigen.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Compare the primary and secondary responses.
markscheme: The secondary response reaches a higher peak antibody concentration.
The secondary response reaches its peak sooner / has a shorter delay.
markschemeJa: 二次応答はより高い抗体濃度ピークに達する。
二次応答はより早くピークに達する／遅延が短い。
parts.modelAnswer: The secondary response is faster and larger.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 二次応答はより速く大きいです。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Calculate how many days earlier the secondary response reaches its peak.

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain why the secondary response is faster.
markscheme: First exposure generates antigen-specific memory cells.
On re-exposure, memory cells rapidly undergo clonal expansion / differentiate into effector cells, producing a rapid response.
markschemeJa: 初回曝露で抗原特異的記憶細胞が形成される。
再曝露時に記憶細胞が速やかにクローン増殖・エフェクター細胞へ分化し迅速な応答を起こす。
parts.modelAnswer: Memory cells formed after the first exposure respond rapidly on re-exposure.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 初回曝露でできた記憶細胞が再曝露時に迅速に反応します。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Yeast was supplied with different sugars and carbon dioxide production was measured.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Identify the sugar producing the greatest carbon dioxide volume.
markscheme: Glucose.
markschemeJa: グルコース。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Calculate the mean carbon dioxide production rate for glucose over 12 minutes.
markscheme: 18.0 cm³ was produced in 12 min.
markschemeJa: 12分で18.0 cm³生成。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain why carbon dioxide production can indicate the rate of yeast metabolism under these conditions.
markscheme: Yeast metabolism of sugars can produce carbon dioxide while releasing energy.
With other variables controlled, more carbon dioxide per unit time indicates a faster carbon-dioxide-producing metabolic pathway.
markschemeJa: 酵母の糖代謝ではエネルギー放出に伴い二酸化炭素を生じうる。
他条件一定なら単位時間あたりCO₂が多いほどその代謝経路が速い。
parts.modelAnswer: More carbon dioxide per unit time indicates a faster relevant metabolic pathway when other conditions are controlled.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 他条件が一定なら単位時間あたりのCO₂量が多いほど関連代謝速度が高いと考えられます。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Suggest one variable that should be controlled.
markscheme: Temperature / pH / yeast concentration / sugar concentration / time.
markschemeJa: 温度／pH／酵母濃度／糖濃度／時間。
parts.modelAnswerJa: 例えば温度を一定にします。
